title: 万用表：看见电压
summary: 从这一课起，电压不再是看不见的：两支表笔放哪里，读数就是哪两点的差。
description: 用万用表的电压档读面包板上的电压：读数 = 红表笔那点的电压 − 黑表笔那点的电压；黑表笔不放时默认在 GND。电路是一个分压器：9 V 电池 → R1（1 kΩ）→ 结点 M → R2（2.2 kΩ）→ GND。

cards.title: 先量一个电池
text: 搭一个两电阻的小电路，然后把万用表的红表笔点到 **+ 轨**上。
右上角的万用表屏幕会显示一个数。它在量什么？

cards.title: 电压是两点之间的
text: - 万用表有两支表笔。**读数 = 红表笔那点 − 黑表笔那点。**
- 只放红表笔时，黑表笔默认在 **GND**，读到的就是“这一点对 GND 的电压”，叫**结点电压**。
- 两支表笔放在一个元件两端，读到的就是**这个元件两端的电压**。
![](fig:probes)
- 红黑对调，读数只变符号：电压没变，变的是你选的参考方向。
- 表笔点在什么都没接的孔上，那一点**悬空**，没有确定的电压，屏幕显示“悬空”。

cards.title: 量三个电压
text: 电路：9 V → R1（1 kΩ）→ 结点 M（第 5 列）→ R2（2.2 kΩ）→ GND。
先用分压公式 $V_M = 9 \times \frac{2.2}{1 + 2.2}$ 预测，再去量。下面的测量题会先让你写预测。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **红减黑。** 黑表笔放哪里，哪里就是“0”。
- R1 两端的电压 + M 对 GND 的电压 = 电池电压：这就是 KVL 的影子，后面会正式学。
- **真实的表**：数字万用表电压档有约 10 MΩ 的输入电阻。量 kΩ 级电路时看不出影响；量 MΩ 级的电阻时，表和电阻并联，读数会明显偏小。真实的表笔点在悬空的点上会显示一个乱跳的数，而不是“悬空”。

caption.text: 读数 = 红表笔那点 − 黑表笔那点。上面的表跨在 R1 两端，读 R1 的电压；右边的表黑表笔在 GND，读 M 点的结点电压。

i18n.en: Reading = red-probe point − black-probe point. The top meter spans R1 and reads its voltage; the right one has its black probe on GND and reads the node voltage at M.

en.title: The multimeter: seeing voltage
en.summary: From this lesson on, voltage is no longer invisible: where you put the two probes decides which two points you compare.
en.description: Read voltages on the board with the multimeter's voltage range: reading = voltage at the red probe − voltage at the black probe; with the black probe not placed it sits on GND. The circuit is a divider: 9 V battery → R1 (1 kΩ) → node M → R2 (2.2 kΩ) → GND.
steps: Pick **Battery** (9 V): red lead (+) in **`tp1`**, black lead (−) in **`tn1`**.
**Resistor R1**: **`tp5`** and **`a5`**, set to **`1 kΩ`** in Properties. (Then click the Lesson tab to come back here.)
**Resistor R2**: **`c5`** and **`c12`**, set to **`2.2 kΩ`**. Column 5 is **node M**: R1 and R2 meet here.
**Jumper** **`a12`** → **`tn12`**: R2's lower end goes to GND and the current has a loop.
Pick **Multimeter** and click **`tp10`** for the red probe. The black probe not placed = on GND. Look at the top right: that is the + rail relative to GND — the battery voltage.
Move the red probe to **`d5`** (node M). The reading is M's voltage to GND — write your prediction in the questions below before you look.
Across R1: red probe on **`tp8`**, hold **Shift** and click **`e5`** for the black probe. Now you read the + rail minus M.
Swap the probes: red probe on **`d5`**, **Shift** + click **`tp8`** for the black probe. How did the reading change?
Red probe on **`h20`** — nothing is plugged into that column. What does the display say?
Press **Check my circuit**, place the probes as each question says and type in your readings.
hints: Think it through: the reading is the red probe's point minus the black probe's point. With the black probe not placed, it is on GND.
Node M is column 5: the lower end of R1 and the upper end of R2 are both in that column. To measure across R1, put one probe on the + rail and the other on column 5.
The voltage across R1 plus M's voltage to GND equals the battery voltage; swapping the probes gives the negative of the reading.
tests: Powered: the voltage at M lies between 0 and the battery voltage

measurements.ask: Red probe on the + rail (red line), black left on GND: the voltage across the battery
measurements.explain: The 9V battery has 1.5 Ω inside; 2.8 mA lowers its terminal voltage by only 4 mV, so you read almost exactly 9 V.

measurements.ask: Red probe on column 5 (node M), black on GND: the voltage of M to GND
Red probe on the + rail, black probe (Shift + click) on column 5: the voltage across R1
Swap the probes: red on column 5, black on the + rail. What does it read? (with its sign)
measurements.explain: Same size, opposite sign: the voltage didn't change, the reference direction (which point counts as +) did.

measurements.ask: With the red probe on the empty hole h20, what does the meter show?
choices: "Floating": nothing is connected to that column, it has no defined voltage
measurements.explain: An empty strip is not part of any node of the circuit. A real meter shows a small wandering number there — it isn't 0 V, it just means nothing.

cards.title: Measure a battery first
text: Build a small two-resistor circuit, then touch the multimeter's red probe to the **+ rail**.
The meter display in the top right shows a number. What is it measuring?

cards.title: A voltage is between two points
text: - A multimeter has two probes. **Reading = the red probe's point − the black probe's point.**
- With only the red probe placed, the black one sits on **GND** by default: you read "this point relative to GND", called a **node voltage**.
- With the probes on the two ends of one part, you read **the voltage across that part**.
![](fig:probes)
- Swap red and black and only the sign changes: the voltage is the same, your chosen reference direction is not.
- A probe on a hole with nothing in it touches a **floating** point with no defined voltage; the display shows "floating".

cards.title: Measure three voltages
text: Circuit: 9 V → R1 (1 kΩ) → node M (column 5) → R2 (2.2 kΩ) → GND.
Predict with the divider formula $V_M = 9 \times \frac{2.2}{1 + 2.2}$ first, then measure. The questions below ask for your prediction before the reading.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Red minus black.** Wherever the black probe sits is "zero".
- The voltage across R1 plus M's voltage to GND equals the battery voltage — a first glimpse of KVL, which comes properly later.

- **Real meters**: a digital multimeter on volts has about 10 MΩ of input resistance. In kΩ circuits you won't notice it; across MΩ resistors the meter sits in parallel and reads noticeably low. On a floating point a real meter shows a wandering number, not "floating".

tests.name: 通电：M 点电压在 0 和电池电压之间

compare:
**对比**：电流 I = 9 V / (1 kΩ + 2.2 kΩ) ≈ 2.81 mA（电池内阻 1.5 Ω 可以忽略）。
- 电池两端 ≈ 9.00 V；
- M 对 GND：2.2 kΩ × 2.81 mA ≈ **6.18 V**；
- R1 两端（红在 + 轨，黑在 M）：1 kΩ × 2.81 mA ≈ **2.81 V**；交换表笔后 ≈ **−2.81 V**；
- 6.18 + 2.81 ≈ 9.0：沿着回路，各段电压加起来等于电池电压（KVL）。

measurements.ask: 红表笔点 + 轨（红线那条），黑表笔留在 GND：电池两端的电压
measurements.explain: 9V 电池有 1.5 Ω 内阻，2.8 mA 的电流只让端电压低 4 mV，所以几乎正好是 9 V。

measurements.ask: 红表笔点第 5 列（结点 M），黑表笔在 GND：M 对 GND 的电压
红表笔点 + 轨，黑表笔（Shift + 单击）点第 5 列：R1 两端的电压
交换表笔：红表笔在第 5 列，黑表笔在 + 轨，读数是多少？（带符号）
measurements.explain: 数值一样，符号相反：电压没变，变的是参考方向（谁当“+”）。

measurements.ask: 红表笔点在空的 h20 时，万用表显示什么？
choices: “悬空”：那一列什么都没接，没有确定的电压
measurements.explain: 没接任何东西的金属条不属于电路的任何结点。真实的表在这里会显示一个乱跳的小数——它不是 0 V，只是没意义。

steps.text: **电阻 R1**：**`tp5`** 和 **`a5`**，「属性」里设 **`1 kΩ`**。（写完属性点「课程」标签回到这里。）
**跳线** **`a12`** → **`tn12`**：R2 的下端接到 GND，电流有了回路。
选**「万用表」**，单击 **`tp10`** 放红表笔。黑表笔没放 = 在 GND。看右上角：这是 + 轨对 GND 的电压，也就是电池电压。
红表笔改点 **`d5`**（结点 M）。读数是 M 对 GND 的电压——先在下面的测量题里写预测再看。
量 R1 两端：红表笔点 **`tp8`**，按住 **Shift** 单击 **`e5`** 放黑表笔。现在读的是 + 轨减去 M。
对调表笔：红表笔点 **`d5`**，**Shift** + 单击 **`tp8`** 放黑表笔。读数怎么变了？
红表笔点 **`h20`**——那一列什么都没插。屏幕显示什么？
点**「检查我的电路」**，按测量题的说明放好表笔，把读数填进去。

hints: 先想清楚：读数是红表笔那点减去黑表笔那点。黑表笔没放时它在 GND。
结点 M 是第 5 列：R1 的下端和 R2 的上端都插在这一列。量 R1 两端，表笔要分别点在 + 轨和第 5 列。
R1 两端的电压 + M 对 GND 的电压 = 电池电压；交换表笔后读数是原来的相反数。
